parameters.name: ClusterId
parameters.description:
The ID of the container cluster.

>  You can call the [DescribeGroupedContainerInstances](~~DescribeGroupedContainerInstances~~) operation to query the IDs of container clusters.

parameters.name: From
parameters.description: The ID of the request source. Set the value to sas.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun sas get-cluster-susp-event-statistics --cluster-id c6094b964bfc145fe9e418c869e7e0000 --from sas --api-version 2018-12-03 --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun sas GetClusterSuspEventStatistics --region cn-hangzhou --ClusterId c6094b964bfc145fe9e418c869e7e0000 --From sas
